summary: Frontend regression + feature testing for The Squared Room static site. Verified section ordering (Método before Coach), removal of breathing protocols + Wim Hof card, and new Blog section with 17 expandable articles. All 5 requested test areas passed cleanly.

test_results.section_order: PASS - method-section at scrollY=1836 appears immediately after About (1080) and before Coach (~3553). Order: Hero -> About -> Método(metodo) -> Coach -> Marquee -> ... -> Blog -> Contact.
test_results.method_section_content: PASS - All 6 pillars present (method-pillar-0..5). method-cta-button present. Zero breathing-protocol-* and zero wim-hof-card elements found (correctly removed).
test_results.method_cta_scroll: PASS - Clicking method-cta-button scrolls to #contacto (in viewport, top=250).
test_results.blog_section: PASS - blog-section present at #blog. Exactly 17 blog-article-N cards (0..16) and 17 blog-toggle-N buttons. Toggle expand/collapse works: 'Leer más' -> click -> 'Leer menos' -> click -> 'Leer más'.
test_results.regression: PASS - contact-submit-button present, floating WhatsApp link (wa.me) present, results/transformations sections intact. No functional console errors (only benign 'compute-pressure permissions policy' browser warning). 8/74 [data-reveal] elements have opacity<0.1 which are the ones below the viewport awaiting scroll reveal - expected behavior, not stuck.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Static Spanish site, no backend. All feature requests from iteration 7 verified live at https://turquoise-gym.preview.emergentagent.com. Key data-testids in use: method-section, method-pillar-0..5, method-cta-button, blog-section, blog-article-0..16, blog-toggle-0..16, contact-submit-button.
